result.reason: The clause does not reach either playbook position. It permits Vendor to assign without consent to an affiliate, contrary to the preferred position and beyond the fallback, which allows consent-free assignment only to successors. It also omits the preferred prohibition on assignment to a Customer competitor. The added change-of-control protection is consistent with the preferred position but was not necessary to remove an existing termination right. Unrelated terms, including the consent standard for other assignments and restrictions on subcontracting, are preserved, and the drafting is generally professional, although the margin comment does not disclose the additional Vendor affiliate-assignment right.
